text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. It'll be our first race since we changed up Nishino Flower's training method.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wake up rather early and head out to the track. I have a hunch of who I might find there, and sure enough, when I arrive…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huff… puff…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer?! What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as I suspected, Nishino Flower has come out here to try and shake off her pre-race anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. You saw right through me. I guess I am a little nervous…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm excited as well—really, I am. But…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm just a scaredy-cat at heart… Even though I'm growing on the outside, I still feel like a little kid on the inside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It doesn't feel right to tell her not to force herself to change, or that she's fine just the way she is. Instead, what I really want to tell her is…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: C-cool? Me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not only did she skip grades, she's been running the best she can even though everyone else is older. Even now, she's working hard to overcome her obstacles.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm… I'm cool! Me! Cool!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow, I feel full of courage now! You're so good at cheering people up, Trainer! ♪
choice_data_list: Let's go show the world the new Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! My body feels light as air!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm ready to Bakushin at my very best! Speed is power, and power is speed!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You're certainly in great form. I can see lightning flashing inside you…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Your brilliance shines all the brighter on sprints. But I have no intention of giving up the lead.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Not to you… nor to the adorable flower.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So you're saying I'm faster than light? Thanks! Let's do our best today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: All right, Zephyr, let's do some cheers! Yelling out loud is perfect for loosening up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Time to Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Bakushin.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Everyone's so fired up… But I guess they would be. They've put in so much effort.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But so have I!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Flower. The direction of your wind has changed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The direction of my wind? Oh! Yes, it has!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm a new me today! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I see. So that's what happened.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see how far upon the wind the flower's scent will travel.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm excited too!
